_comment: Copilot deploy/runtime handoff for W4 Epic 10 frontend changes. Goal: deploy the latest production-facing UX/UI changes to SIT and verify the live review surface is using the intended artifact.
title: Deploy Epic 10 W4 UX/UI changes to SIT and verify the production-facing review surface
objective: Deploy the latest Epic 10 W4 frontend changes from dev to SIT via the Openclaw control-plane workflow, verify that the live `/phase2/prototype` surface is serving the new production-facing UI, and return concise runtime proof for the next PO review step.

production_review_surface.rule: This is the only valid W4 SIT review surface.

legacy_demo_surface.rule: Reference only. Do not use this as the primary proof of deployment.

static_fallback.rule: Parity check only. Confirm it does not serve a stale shell after deploy.

deploy_context.rule: Use the SIT control-plane workflow in Openclaw. Do not modify production VPS manually outside the approved Git + GitHub Actions path.

implemented_locally: Epic 10 W4 Export screen rebuilt on src/frontend/main-ux-ui.html as full-page flow with mode picker, inline column adjustment, inline preview, and no modal-first export path.
Company entry relabeled toward Settings and AP/AR tabs split in the company-management UI.
Six Express master template cards added to the Templates screen.
New static regression spec added: tests/e2e/w4-export-uxui.spec.ts.
important_gap: These changes exist only in the current local/code state and have not yet been proven on live SIT in this pass.
Quick Export is still frontend fallback because backend support for template_id:null plus column_overrides is not implemented yet.
The frozen 3-tab Configurator is still not fully rebuilt; this deploy is for the current frontend pass, not final W4 closure.

what_to_do: 1. Confirm the intended app ref/SHA on dev and make sure the SIT deploy workflow will use that exact ref.
2. Deploy the current Epic 10 W4 frontend changes to SIT through D:/01_gitrepo/Openclaw/.github/workflows/deploy-ai-accounting-copilot-sit.yml.
3. Verify the public routes after deploy with Basic Auth enabled:

4. Prove that /phase2/prototype is serving the new production-facing UI and not a stale artifact. Use concrete markers from the new UI where possible, such as the mode-picker/export structure or the moved export live-bridge ids.
5. Check whether /index.html still behaves consistently with /phase2/prototype after the deploy and cache-control fixes.
6. Run the appropriate smoke/clickthrough proof that Copilot can execute in its lane, and if a browser-driven run is delegated, report exactly what remains for the PO/Claude review step.
7. Return a concise route-and-artifact proof summary plus any remaining blocker before PO review.
acceptance_criteria: The SIT deploy workflow completes successfully against the intended dev ref/SHA.
/phase2/prototype is reachable on SIT and serves the intended current production-facing UI artifact.
/workflow-demo remains the legacy reference surface and is not mistaken for the production-facing proof surface.
/index.html does not serve a stale cached shell after deploy.
Basic Auth remains enabled on SIT.
A final status summary clearly states whether the system is ready for the next PO live review step.
credentials_handling: SIT Basic Auth credentials, SSH credentials, and app login credentials are operator-supplied out of band. Do not commit, print, or store plaintext credentials in repo files, workflow logs, or handoff artifacts.

report_sections: Files or workflows changed if any
Proof that /phase2/prototype is the new artifact

final_instruction_to_copilot: Do the deploy and verification work. Do not stop at reading docs or describing a plan. If the deploy cannot be completed, return the exact blocker and the exact step where it failed.
